title: IP-MT281-ParityMatrixArtifact

scope.summary:
GOAL: Stand up the machine-readable IDE-parity matrix + a re-runnable Rust checker that is the honest tracking spine for the whole IP family (MT-282..290). Operator judgment 2026-07-21: 'the notes module is still missing a lot of VS Code / Antigravity features to be a professional grade IDE.' This MT does NOT close a feature gap itself; it records, in one auditable artifact, every VS Code / Antigravity baseline feature that was checked against the native editors, its verdict (PRESENT | PARTIAL | MISSING | COVERED_ELSEWHERE(owner) | DEFERRED(reason)), the evidence that verdict rests on, and — for every non-PRESENT row — the owning MT that closes it or the explicit DEFERRED reason. The checker fails CI if any MISSING/PARTIAL row has no owning MT and no DEFERRED reason, so the parity picture can never silently rot.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) NEW machine-readable matrix src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/ide_parity/ide_parity_matrix.json (schema hsk.ide_parity_matrix@1) seeded with the full verified initial matrix embedded in this contract (see scope.embedded_parity_matrix); (b) NEW checker src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/test_ide_parity_matrix.rs that loads the matrix, validates schema + invariants, and asserts every non-PRESENT row is either owned by an MT id in this WP or carries a DEFERRED reason; (c) [[test]] registration in src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml (name = 'test_ide_parity_matrix', harness = true). A snapshot copy of each passing run is written under the external HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT (product evidence), never into the repo target dir. NO product-source edits; NO backend edits; this is a proof/tracking artifact only.

DETAILED SPEC:
1. hsk.ide_parity_matrix@1 row shape (each object): { feature_id (kebab-case, unique), baseline_source ('vscode' | 'antigravity' | 'obsidian-class'), area ('code_editor' | 'rich_editor' | 'shell' | 'both'), status ('PRESENT' | 'PARTIAL' | 'MISSING' | 'COVERED_ELSEWHERE' | 'DEFERRED'), owner (for COVERED_ELSEWHERE: the owning WP/MT string; else null), owning_mt (for MISSING/PARTIAL: the IP MT id that closes it; else null), deferred_reason (for DEFERRED: a non-empty reason; else null), evidence_ref (the module path or task id the verdict was read from) }.
2. The matrix file top-level: { schema_id: 'hsk.ide_parity_matrix@1', generated_at_utc, source_worktree: 'wtc-native-editors-v1', rows: [ ... ] }.
3. Checker invariants (each a distinct assertion): (INV-1) schema_id matches and every row parses to the typed Row; (INV-2) feature_id values are unique; (INV-3) status is one of the five literals; (INV-4) every MISSING or PARTIAL row has a non-null owning_mt that matches the /^MT-\d{3}$/ shape AND names an MT file that exists on disk in THIS packet dir (the checker globs .GOV/... is NOT reachable from the crate; instead it validates owning_mt is within the declared IP id range 282..320 and non-null — repo-path coupling is avoided so the test stays disk-agnostic per portability policy); (INV-5) every COVERED_ELSEWHERE row has a non-null owner string; (INV-6) every DEFERRED row has a non-empty deferred_reason; (INV-7) PRESENT/COVERED_ELSEWHERE rows have null owning_mt (a closed feature must not also claim an open MT). The checker prints a compact verdict-count summary line (PRESENT/PARTIAL/MISSING/COVERED_ELSEWHERE/DEFERRED) to stdout.
4. Re-runnable: the checker is a pure test over the committed JSON — no network, no PG, no GUI. It is the gate a later validator re-runs to confirm the IP family's tracking artifact is internally consistent. When a new IP MT is added or a verdict flips, the matrix JSON is edited and this checker re-run; drift between the matrix and the actual MT set surfaces as a failing invariant.
5. Product evidence: on a passing run the checker copies the matrix to $HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT/wp-kernel-017/mt-281/ide_parity_matrix.<run_id>.json (external artifacts root only; skip the copy with a logged note if the env var is unset — never write into the repo).

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Author ide_parity_matrix.json embedding EXACTLY the rows in scope.embedded_parity_matrix (the full verified initial matrix from the 2026-07-21 source inspection of wtc-native-editors-v1).
2. Author test_ide_parity_matrix.rs: typed Row + Matrix structs (serde), a loader, and one test function per invariant INV-1..7 plus a summary-count test; use serde_json only (already a workspace dep).
3. Register the [[test]] in Cargo.toml.
4. Run the checker; confirm all invariants pass on the seeded matrix; capture the stdout verdict-count summary as evidence.
5. Write the external-artifact snapshot; record the run_id.

rows.evidence_ref: no peek module in code_editor/; code_nav gives def/refs as side panels only, no inline peek overlay
no snippet tab-stop/placeholder engine in code_editor/; 'snippet' only appears as search-preview/alias strings; rich-editor slash_commands is a distinct command menu, not code-snippet expansion
no format_on_save / trim-trailing-whitespace-on-save / final-newline trigger; formatting.rs is manual Format Document/Selection only

sticky_scroll pins enclosing lines but there is NO clickable path+symbol breadcrumb bar; the only breadcrumb code is graph/sidebar_panel.rs (Loom block navigation), not an editor breadcrumb
gutter.rs GutterMarkerKind = Diagnostic|Breakpoint|FoldTriangle only; source_control.rs is a change-LIST panel, not an in-editor added/modified/deleted gutter with revert-hunk
source_control.rs dispatches a blame DISPLAY event to a panel; there is no end-of-line inline blame annotation in the editor body

Revisit as a WP-011 shell item if the operator prioritizes it.

interop/interaction_bus.rs carries clipboard/selection only; no 'add selection/file/symbol to agent context' path feeding the WP-017 session API (MT-007) initial_prompt/steer context

forbidden_paths: src/frontend/handshake_native/src/** (no product-source edits; this MT is the tracking spine, not a feature)
acceptance_criteria: src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/ide_parity/ide_parity_matrix.json exists, is valid JSON, has schema_id 'hsk.ide_parity_matrix@1', and embeds EXACTLY the rows in scope.embedded_parity_matrix (every candidate from the baseline scan with verdict + evidence_ref).
Every MISSING or PARTIAL row has a non-null owning_mt in the IP range (MT-282..MT-320); every COVERED_ELSEWHERE row has a non-null owner; every DEFERRED row has a non-empty deferred_reason.
test_ide_parity_matrix.rs implements invariants INV-1..INV-7 as distinct assertions and prints a verdict-count summary line to stdout.
The checker is re-runnable with no network/PG/GUI dependency (pure test over committed JSON).
cargo test -p handshake-native ide_parity_matrix compiles and every invariant test passes on the seeded matrix.
A passing-run snapshot is written under $HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT only (never the repo target dir); if the env var is unset the copy is skipped with a logged note.
No file under src/frontend/handshake_native/src/** or src/backend/** is modified (grep-provable: only tests/ide_parity/**, the checker, and Cargo.toml [[test]] change).
proof_targets: python -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(open('src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/ide_parity/ide_parity_matrix.json')); rows=m['rows']; bad=[r for r in rows if r['status'] in ('MISSING','PARTIAL') and not r.get('owning_mt')]; print('unowned_open:',len(bad)); assert not bad"

python -c "import json; m=json.load(open('src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/ide_parity/ide_parity_matrix.json')); ids=[r['feature_id'] for r in m['rows']]; assert len(ids)==len(set(ids)), 'dup feature_id'"
git diff --name-only | grep -vE 'tests/ide_parity/|test_ide_parity_matrix.rs|Cargo.toml' | grep -q . && echo 'UNEXPECTED_EDIT' || echo 'SCOPE_CLEAN'

inv3: status literal is one of the five allowed

inv5: COVERED_ELSEWHERE rows carry a non-null owner

implementation_notes: Verified grounding 2026-07-21 (wtc-native-editors-v1): code_editor/ modules present = breakpoints, buffer, code_actions, code_nav, cursor, diff_editor_panel, diff_engine, editor_view, file_meta, find_replace, folding, formatting, gutter, highlight, jump_history, keymap, keymap_settings, language_mode, line_ops, lsp_client, minimap, navigation, note_refs_panel, outline, panel, render_decorations, rename, signature_help, sticky_scroll, symbol_palette, virtual_lines, word_wrap. rich_editor/ modules = daily_notes, document_model, embeds, find_replace, formatting, inline_tags, markdown_render, outline_panel, properties, reading_mode, renderer, save, slash_commands, wikilinks. src/source_control.rs is a change-LIST panel (SCM), not an editor gutter. graph/sidebar_panel.rs owns the ONLY breadcrumb code (Loom navigation).

The matrix is a TRACKING artifact under GLOBAL-GOVARTIFACTS (machine-readable, non-authority projection); it is not a spec. When an IP MT lands or a verdict flips, edit the JSON and re-run the checker.
INV-4 deliberately validates owning_mt by shape + IP range, NOT by resolving a .GOV path, so the test stays disk-agnostic (GLOBAL-PORTABILITY) — the crate must not reach into the governance tree.
Cross-family seams (reference only): every owning_mt in this matrix (MT-282..290) is a sibling IP contract in this same packet; the checker does not import them, it only asserts the id shape.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Machine-readable parity-tracking artifact + a pure Rust checker test; there is no operator-facing surface. The verdict-count stdout line and the external-artifact snapshot are the trace projection.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Internal tracking/proof artifact with no operator-visible product behavior; the IP feature MTs (MT-282..290) each carry their own UserManual obligations.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Pure synchronous checker test emits no runtime business events.
The verdict-count summary + per-invariant assertion failures give a no-context model an exact, typed reason why the parity matrix is inconsistent, with the offending feature_id named.
No long-running child process; the checker is a synchronous test.

risk_if_missed: Without a single machine-readable parity matrix + checker, the IP family's gap list lives only in prose: verdicts drift from the code, closed gaps still read as open (and vice versa), and no gate proves that every MISSING feature actually has an owning MT. The whole 'professional-grade IDE parity' claim becomes unauditable.

risks: RISK-1: Matrix rots — a feature verdict flips to PRESENT in code but the matrix still says MISSING (or an MT closes a gap and the row is never updated), so the artifact lies about parity.
RISK-2: Fake ownership — a MISSING row points at an owning_mt that does not exist or is outside the IP range, so the gate passes while the gap is actually unowned.
RISK-3: Repo coupling — the checker reaches into .GOV/ to resolve owning_mt files, breaking disk-agnostic portability and coupling the product crate to the governance tree.
RISK-4: Evidence-free verdicts — rows carry a status with no evidence_ref, so a reviewer cannot tell whether PRESENT was actually verified against source or guessed.
RISK-5: Artifact leak — a passing-run snapshot is written into the repo target dir instead of the external artifacts root, polluting the worktree and git status.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): The checker is the re-run gate; a validator re-runs it after any IP MT lands. INV-7 (PRESENT/COVERED_ELSEWHERE => null owning_mt) forces a deliberate edit when a gap closes, catching stale rows.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): INV-4 asserts owning_mt matches /^MT-\d{3}$/ and is within the declared IP range 282..320; a test fixture with a bogus owning_mt asserts the checker FAILS.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): INV-4 validates by id shape + range only, never by resolving a governance path; a grep proof asserts the checker source contains no '.GOV' or absolute path.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): INV-1 requires evidence_ref to be a non-empty string on every row; a fixture with an empty evidence_ref asserts failure.

CTRL-5 (RISK-5): The snapshot writer targets $HANDSHAKE_ARTIFACTS_ROOT only and skips with a logged note when unset; a scope-clean git-diff proof (only tests/ide_parity/**, checker, Cargo.toml) is part of proof_targets.

research_provenance.source: Direct source inspection 2026-07-21 of wtc-native-editors-v1 src/frontend/handshake_native/src/: enumerated code_editor/mod.rs + rich_editor/mod.rs module maps, source_control.rs (change-list, not editor gutter), graph/sidebar_panel.rs (only breadcrumb code = Loom navigation), gutter.rs (GutterMarkerKind = Diagnostic|Breakpoint|FoldTriangle), editor_view.rs (LSP CompletionPopup only, no ghost-text), interop/interaction_bus.rs (clipboard/selection only). Cross-checked against WP-KERNEL-012 MT titles (parity work: MT-001..108), WP-KERNEL-011 MT titles (shell: CommandPalette MT-016, QuickSwitcher MT-017, split/tabs MT-005/006/007, TerminalLaunch), WP-KERNEL-013/014 stubs (Notion database+templates / DOCX+dual-view excluded), and WP-KERNEL-017 existing families (SC/CS/CX/AP/RO/MM/ML/WM/RD/AC/NA/PD). Baseline feature set from VS Code core + Antigravity/AI-IDE class.
corrections: Command palette is NOT a gap: it is owned by WP-KERNEL-011 MT-016 (command_registry.rs). Editor breadcrumbs ARE a gap but only PARTIAL: sticky_scroll covers the enclosing-scope pin; the clickable path+symbol breadcrumb bar is absent and the only breadcrumb code is the Loom graph sidebar.

The SCM surface that exists (source_control.rs) is a change-LIST panel peer of the React SourceControlPanel; it is NOT an in-editor dirty-diff gutter and NOT inline blame — both are confirmed MISSING and owned by MT-285/MT-286.
